'''2008 Worlds Team James Booker LS Local Uprising''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[James Booker]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Sheet title Mr. Klown never threw me under the bus. Starting written Y4; treated as Local Uprising (Naboo/Jedi/Home One). Abbreviations expanded best-effort.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[James Booker]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Local Uprising / Liberation|Local Uprising]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
